run_analysis.sh.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P3's frozen analysis on L's October rows and the laptop's W rows, from the clone src at
# ANALYSIS_COMMIT e61e78f: analysis/analyse.py, then analysis/macros.py, into OUT (outside the clone).
# The row files in the order of October's run (confirm1/run_analysis2.sh), the laptop's files in W's
# three places. Gates: L's gate-L.json and the laptop's gate-W.json (p3-gate-w-5) alone, so no desktop
# row can bind. Python isolated (-I) in UTF-8 mode (-X utf8), the venv of October (3.14.5, numpy 2.5.0).
# Usage: run_analysis.sh OUT
set -euo pipefail
W=/c/Users/alext/lab/p3/laptop-w-analysis
OUT=$1
PY=/c/Users/alext/lab/p3/confirm1/venv/Scripts/python.exe
SRC=$W/src
IN=$W/in
mkdir -p "$OUT"
"$PY" -I -X utf8 "$SRC/analysis/analyse.py" \
  --seeds "$IN/seeds.json" \
  --pilot "$IN/pilot.json" \
  --rule-e "$IN/rule_e.json" \
  --gate "$IN/gate-L.json" --gate "$IN/gate-W.json" \
  --rows "$W/xL/2026-10-05-pc1/cost-L/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/x/p3-cost-w/p3-cost-w/out/cost/out/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/xL/2026-10-05-ml1/m-L/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/x/p3-m1-w/p3-m1-w/out/m/out/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/xL/2026-10-05-bk1-bs1/b3-L/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/xL/2026-10-07-sl3/s-L/windows.jsonl" \
  --rows "$W/x/p3-s10-w/p3-s10-w/out/s10/out/windows.jsonl" \
  --out "$OUT"
"$PY" -I -X utf8 "$SRC/analysis/macros.py" "$OUT/summary.json" --out "$OUT/macros.tex"
(cd "$OUT" && sha256sum summary.json decisions.csv macros.tex > SHA256SUMS)

run_hardcase.sh.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# B1's and B2's counts and decisions (paper/hardcase_macros.py, the reading of 2026-10-07) from L's
# hl1 and the laptop's p3hardw, with summary.json's b1_failures from the laptop analysis (out1), and
# hc1's descriptive competitors' table (L, October). From the clone src at e61e78f, whose
# paper/hardcase_macros.py and bench/run/whardcase_run.py equal b0d6839's. Writes OUT, never under results/.
# Usage: run_hardcase.sh OUT.tex
set -euo pipefail
W=/c/Users/alext/lab/p3/laptop-w-analysis
PY=/c/Users/alext/lab/p3/confirm1/venv/Scripts/python.exe
"$PY" -I -X utf8 "$W/src/paper/hardcase_macros.py" \
  --server L hl1 "$W/xL/2026-10-05-pc1/hard-L/hardcases.jsonl" "$W/xL/2026-10-05-pc1/hard-L/hardcases-table-hl1.json" \
  --server W p3hardw "$W/x/p3-hard-w/p3-hard-w/out/hard/out/hardcases.jsonl" "$W/x/p3-hard-w/p3-hard-w/out/hard/out/hardcases-table-p3hardw.json" \
  --summary "$W/out1/summary.json" \
  --competitors hc1 "$W/xL/2026-10-07-hc1/hardcomp-L/competitor_cases.jsonl" \
  --out "$1"
